blocks.text: Condo buildings in Sullivan Station
Viva (Viva Living / Viva Sullivan Ridge) — 14398 60 Avenue

A 4-storey mixed-use building by Four Square Properties at 60 Avenue & 144 Street: the presale record states 71 condominiums and five retail units, with interiors by The Collaborative Design Studio. Completion timing conflicts between sources: the presale record gave an expected completion of March 2025, a later project information packet gave an estimated completion of January 2026, the building directory records Viva as built in 2025, and current listings record a 2026 build year. A current listing records pets: Yes.
Latitude — 14358 60 Avenue

An Apartment/Condo building in Sullivan Station, built 2013: current listings record sub-type Apartment/Condo, 4 storeys, frame-wood construction with brick and fibre-cement exterior, freehold strata title, and amenities including clubhouse, exercise centre, guest suite and landscaped courtyard; one listing credits Porte Communities as builder.

items.t: Sullivan Station is a residential sub-area of the City of Surrey, in the Newton community. It is the SnapStats / board sub-area name for this area in the September 2026 report; the City does not publish a separate "Sullivan Station" plan boundary.

Plan status — read this before relying on any older plan document: the South Newton plan was rescinded by the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan update and is no longer in effect; development in this area is led by the Official Community Plan, and on December 2, 2024 Council endorsed Corporate Report R246, which updated land use designations to reflect current market conditions.

items.t: The plan most listing copy still cites no longer exists. The South Newton plan was rescinded by the Surrey 2050 OCP update; the governing documents are now OCP Bylaw No. 21900 and Zoning Bylaw No. 12000, with designations updated by Corporate Report R246 on December 2, 2024. Any marketing that quotes "the South Newton NCP" as current is quoting a dead plan.

"Sullivan Station" is a board name, not a City plan name. The City's own names for this area are Sullivan, Sullivan Heights and South Newton, and the City publishes no Sullivan Station boundary — searches run under only the board name miss City documents filed under the other three.
A brand-new school redrew the catchment conversation in January 2026.

No hospital sits inside the sub-area. The serving facilities are Surrey Memorial Hospital, 13750 96 Ave, and the Surrey-Newton Urgent and Primary Care Centre, 6830 King George Blvd — both west/northwest of the Sullivan ground.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Sullivan Station

items.t: Form B diligence (all 9 strata complexes above): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page.

Flood and creeks: the Serpentine lowlands lie south of Highway 10. South Newton's fish-bearing creeks (Archibald Creek headwaters, Sullivan Heights Creek, Hyland Creek tributaries) carry riparian/setback rules that can limit building envelopes on creek-side lots.

The "Sullivan" 55+ complex is not in Sullivan Station — and is not a strata. Sullivan Mews (15020 66A Ave) is filed by MLS under East Newton and is a membership purchase (cash only per its listing, monthly fee covering taxes, heat, electricity, management, insurance and water). The name, the sub-area and the tenure all mislead in different directions.

Two Polygon phases share one clubhouse story. The Uplands (2005) and Oaklands (2006–2007) listings both market the same 10,000 sq ft Panorama Place clubhouse (outdoor pool, hot tub, gyms, theatre room, guest suites) — a buyer comparing the two phases is comparing unit and strata finances, not amenity sets.

blocks.text: Sullivan Station home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

180 townhomes sold in Sullivan Station with a median price of $785,000 (the middle half sold between $720,000 and $850,000), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 97.9% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $486 per square foot, a median year built of 2014 and a median strata fee of $366 a month. 5 condos sold in Sullivan Station with a median price of $574,000, taking a median of 23 days to sell at 96.2% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $565 per square foot, a median year built of 2013 and a median strata fee of $454 a month.
